sources.quote: Kepler-5 is a star located in the constellation Cygnus in the field of view of the Kepler Mission, a NASA project aimed at detecting planets in transit of, or passing in front of, their host stars as seen from Earth.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Esteves et al. 2015.
